data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate increased net technical reserves by GBP 8.8m in respect of prior years (2018: GBP 1.5m) as a result of deteriorations on a whole account quota share of AXA XL.

prior_year_events.event_name: Deteriorations on a whole account quota share of AXA XL
prior_year_events.impact_description: Deteriorations on a whole account quota share of AXA XL led to an increase in net technical reserves in respect of prior years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2018 was GBP 262.747m. During 2019 the syndicate reported an increase in prior-year technical reserves, with net prior-year deterioration of GBP 8.8m, driven by deteriorations on a whole-account quota share of AXA XL. This resulted in an overall strengthening of reserves (approximately 3.35% of opening gross claims outstanding). No specific catastrophe names are provided in relation to the prior-year movement; the report emphasises adverse development on a reinsurance quota-share arrangement as the principal cause.
raw_causal_phrases: During the year, the Syndicate increased net technical reserves by GBP 8.8m in respect of prior years (2018: GBP 1.5m) as a result of deteriorations on a whole account quota share of AXA XL.
The decrease in the loss ratio is primarily due to the improvements to risk selection discussed above and lower severity of 2019 catastrophe events compared to 2018.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding under Technical provisions, 2018 column). The report explicitly states a net prior-year deterioration of GBP 8.8m (2019) but does not present a gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure; a gross PYD figure was not found. A gross claims development table (triangle) is present and could be used to derive a gross PYD, but for this extraction the explicitly stated NET figure has been used as no gross movement note was located. Prior-year movement is therefore NET of reinsurance - no gross prior-year movement figure available in the notes. The claims development triangle is provided in GBP 000s on page 21.
